### 了解信息
```{r qc-verify-variables-row2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)
library(here)

# --------------------------------------------------
# project root anchor (your exact setting)
# --------------------------------------------------
here::i_am("analysis/01_data_preprocessing.Rmd")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) read data (xlsx) - robust against type-guessing (Tobacco Use 1)
# --------------------------------------------------
fp <- here("datasets", "CABG-readmission-cohort-for-jtcvs26.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(fp))

# Read header across a wide enough range to include all columns (41 cols ~ up to AO)
hdr <- readxl::read_xlsx(fp, sheet = "in", range = "A1:AO1", .name_repair = "unique")
cols <- names(hdr)

# Force "Tobacco Use 1" to text so it won't be locked as logical when early rows are empty
idx_tu1 <- match("Tobacco Use 1", cols)
stopifnot(!is.na(idx_tu1))

ct <- rep("guess", length(cols))
ct[idx_tu1] <- "text"

# Read the full data range (buffered)
dat <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  fp,
  sheet = "in",
  range = "A1:AO9000",
  col_types = ct,
  .name_repair = "unique"
)

cat("Loaded:", fp, "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dat), " Cols:", ncol(dat), "\n\n")

# --------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# --------------------------------------------------
assert_cols_exist <- function(df, cols, label = "columns") {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    cat("Missing ", label, ":\n", sep = "")
    print(missing)
    stop("Some required columns are missing. Please check column names.")
  }
}

get_uniques <- function(x) sort(unique(x))

# keep only non-missing, non-empty values (useful for Excel columns with big NA blocks)
clean_vals <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (is.character(x2)) x2 <- x2[x2 != ""]
  x2
}

check_binary_01 <- function(x) {
  u <- clean_vals(x)
  all(u %in% c(0, 1))
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# variable groups (aligned to your exact names(dat))
# --------------------------------------------------
race_vars <- c(
  "Race - White",
  "Race - Black / African American",
  "Race - Asian",
  "Race - American Indian / Alaskan Native",
  "Race - Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander",
  "Race Other"
)

binary_vars <- c(
  "Diabetes",
  "Hypertension",
  "Endocarditis",
  "Tobacco Use 2",
  "Sleep Apnea",
  "Illicit Drug Use",
  "Liver Disease",
  "Immunocompromised",
  "PAD",
  "Syncope",
  "CVD",
  "Previous  PCI",   # two spaces, matches your data
  "Prior MI",
  "Readmission"
)

need_unique_vars <- c(
  "Tobacco Use 1",
  "CLD",
  "Pneumonia",
  "Alcohol Use",
  "Num Dis Vessels",
  "Status"
)

gender_var <- "Gender"
serial_var <- "S_no"

# --------------------------------------------------
# verify columns exist
# --------------------------------------------------
assert_cols_exist(dat, race_vars, "race variables")
assert_cols_exist(dat, binary_vars, "binary variables")
assert_cols_exist(dat, need_unique_vars, "unique-value variables")
assert_cols_exist(dat, gender_var, "gender variable")
assert_cols_exist(dat, serial_var, "serial variable")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) binary variable check (still tests 0/1 as your original hypothesis)
# --------------------------------------------------
cat("1) Binary variable check (expect 0/1 + NA)\n")

bin_report <- tibble(
  variable = binary_vars,
  ok_binary_01 = map_lgl(binary_vars, ~ check_binary_01(dat[[.x]])),
  unique_values = map(binary_vars, ~ get_uniques(clean_vals(dat[[.x]])))
)

print(bin_report %>% select(variable, ok_binary_01))

bad_bin <- bin_report %>% filter(!ok_binary_01)
if (nrow(bad_bin) > 0) {
  cat("\nViolations (not in {0,1}):\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bad_bin))) {
    cat("- ", bad_bin$variable[i], ": ",
        paste(bad_bin$unique_values[[i]], collapse = ", "),
        "\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("\nAll listed binary variables satisfy {0,1} (plus NA).\n")
}

cat("\n-----------------------------\n\n")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) unique values for selected variables (robust to big NA blocks)
# --------------------------------------------------
cat("2) Unique values for selected variables (non-missing only)\n")
for (v in need_unique_vars) {
  x2 <- clean_vals(dat[[v]])
  cat("- ", v,
      " (n_unique_nonmissing=", length(unique(x2)), "): ",
      paste(get_uniques(x2), collapse = ", "),
      "\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\n-----------------------------\n\n")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3) gender encoding check (male=1, female=0)
# --------------------------------------------------
cat("3) Gender encoding check (male=1, female=0)\n")

g_uni <- get_uniques(clean_vals(dat[[gender_var]]))
cat("Gender unique values:", paste(g_uni, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (is.numeric(dat[[gender_var]]) || is.integer(dat[[gender_var]])) {
  ok_gender_01 <- check_binary_01(dat[[gender_var]])
  cat("Gender in {0,1}:", ok_gender_01, "\n")
  if (!ok_gender_01) {
    cat("Gender violates {0,1}. Values:", paste(g_uni, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Gender is coded as 0/1. If you also have a text label column, we can cross-check male/female mapping.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Gender is non-numeric (likely labels). Values:", paste(g_uni, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

cat("\n-----------------------------\n\n")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4) remaining variables should be numeric (excluding listed vars + race)
# --------------------------------------------------
cat("4) Remaining variables numeric check\n")

excluded <- unique(c(serial_var, binary_vars, need_unique_vars, gender_var, race_vars))
other_vars <- setdiff(names(dat), excluded)

non_numeric <- tibble(
  variable = other_vars,
  class = map_chr(other_vars, ~ paste(class(dat[[.x]]), collapse = "/"))
) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(variable, ~ is.numeric(dat[[.x]]) || is.integer(dat[[.x]])))

if (nrow(non_numeric) == 0) {
  cat("All remaining variables are numeric/integer as expected.\n")
} else {
  cat("Non-numeric variables found (unexpected under your hypothesis):\n")
  print(non_numeric)

  cat("\nExamples of unique values (first 20 non-missing):\n")
  for (v in non_numeric$variable) {
    x2 <- clean_vals(dat[[v]])
    cat("- ", v, ": ", paste(head(get_uniques(x2), 20), collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
  }
}

cat("\nDone.\n")


```

### 了解信息
```{r qc-categorical-distribution, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# helper: count + percentage for one categorical variable
tabulate_cat <- function(x, var_name) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  n_total <- length(x2)

  tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    category = names(table(x2)),
    n = as.integer(table(x2))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = round(100 * n / n_total, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
}

# variables you want to summarize
cat_vars <- c(
  "Tobacco Use 1",
  "CLD",
  "Pneumonia",
  "Alcohol Use",
  "Num Dis Vessels",
  "Status"
)

# run for all variables and bind together
cat_summary <- map_dfr(cat_vars, ~ tabulate_cat(dat[[.x]], .x))

# print nicely
print(cat_summary, n = Inf)
```

### Data processing
```{r clean-dataset-row2-final-v5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# project root anchor
# --------------------------------------------------
here::i_am("scripts/processing_dataset-v2.Rmd")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) read data (xlsx) - robust against type-guessing
# --------------------------------------------------
fp <- here("datasets", "CABG-readmission-cohort-for-jtcvs26.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(fp))

# header (41 cols ~ up to AO)
hdr <- readxl::read_xlsx(fp, sheet = "in", range = "A1:AO1", .name_repair = "unique")
cols <- names(hdr)

idx_tu1 <- match("Tobacco Use 1", cols)
idx_hgb <- match("Hemoglobin", cols)
stopifnot(!is.na(idx_tu1), !is.na(idx_hgb))

ct <- rep("guess", length(cols))
ct[idx_tu1] <- "text"  # Tobacco Use 1 must be text
ct[idx_hgb] <- "text"  # Hemoglobin sometimes mis-guessed; read as text then parse

dat <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  fp,
  sheet = "in",
  range = "A1:AO9000",
  col_types = ct,
  .name_repair = "unique"
)

cat("Loaded:", fp, "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dat), " Cols:", ncol(dat), "\n\n")

# --------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# --------------------------------------------------
assert_cols_exist <- function(df, cols, label = "columns") {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    cat("Missing ", label, ":\n", sep = "")
    print(missing)
    stop("Some required columns are missing. Please check column names.")
  }
}

yn01 <- function(x, unknown_to_no = TRUE) {
  y <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    y == "yes" ~ 1,
    y == "no"  ~ 0,
    y == "unknown" & unknown_to_no ~ 0,
    y == "unknown" & !unknown_to_no ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

tu1_to_01 <- function(x) {
  t1 <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    t1 %in% c(
      "current every day smoker",
      "current some day smoker",
      "former smoker",
      "smoker, current status (frequency) unknown"
    ) ~ 1,
    t1 %in% c(
      "never smoker",
      "smoking status unknown"
    ) ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# required columns
# --------------------------------------------------
race_cols <- c(
  "Race - White",
  "Race - Black / African American",
  "Race - Asian",
  "Race - American Indian / Alaskan Native",
  "Race - Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander",
  "Race Other"
)

need_cols <- c(
  "S_no",
  "Gender",
  "Tobacco Use 1",
  "Tobacco Use 2",
  "Diabetes",
  "Hypertension",
  "Endocarditis",
  "Sleep Apnea",
  "Illicit Drug Use",
  "Liver Disease",
  "Immunocompromised",
  "PAD",
  "Syncope",
  "CVD",
  "Previous  PCI",
  "Prior MI",
  "CLD",
  "Pneumonia",
  "Alcohol Use",
  "Num Dis Vessels",
  "Status",
  race_cols
)

assert_cols_exist(dat, need_cols, "required columns")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) recode variables + create tobacco_use + race
# --------------------------------------------------
dat_clean <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    # -------------------------
    # Gender: male=1, female=0
    # -------------------------
    Gender = case_when(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(Gender))) == "male"   ~ 1,
      str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(Gender))) == "female" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # -------------------------
    # Binary vars (Yes=1, No=0; Unknown -> No)
    # -------------------------
    Diabetes = yn01(Diabetes, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    Hypertension = yn01(Hypertension, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    Endocarditis = yn01(Endocarditis, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    `Sleep Apnea` = yn01(`Sleep Apnea`, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    `Liver Disease` = yn01(`Liver Disease`, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    Immunocompromised = yn01(Immunocompromised, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    PAD = yn01(PAD, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    Syncope = yn01(Syncope, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    CVD = yn01(CVD, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    `Previous  PCI` = yn01(`Previous  PCI`, unknown_to_no = TRUE),
    `Prior MI` = yn01(`Prior MI`, unknown_to_no = TRUE),

    # Tobacco Use 2 is already Yes/No -> 1/0
    `Tobacco Use 2` = yn01(`Tobacco Use 2`, unknown_to_no = TRUE),

    # Illicit Drug Use: Remote/Recent/Yes -> 1 ; No/Unknown -> 0
    `Illicit Drug Use` = {
      z <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Illicit Drug Use`)))
      case_when(
        z %in% c("yes", "remote", "recent") ~ 1,
        z %in% c("no", "unknown") ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # tobacco_use (final):
    # - If Tobacco Use 2 exists (0/1), use it
    # - Else if Tobacco Use 1 can be mapped, use it
    # - Else NA
    # -------------------------
    tobacco_use = coalesce(`Tobacco Use 2`, tu1_to_01(`Tobacco Use 1`)),

    # -------------------------
    # CLD (ordinal): No=0, Mild=1, Moderate=2, Severe=3, Unknown=NA
    # includes: "Lung disease documented, severity unknown" -> NA
    # -------------------------
    CLD = {
      c1 <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(CLD)))
      case_when(
        c1 == "no" ~ 0,
        c1 == "mild" ~ 1,
        c1 == "moderate" ~ 2,
        c1 == "severe" ~ 3,
        c1 %in% c("unknown", "lung disease documented, severity unknown") ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # Pneumonia (binary): No=0, Remote/Recent=1, Unknown=NA
    # -------------------------
    Pneumonia = {
      p1 <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(Pneumonia)))
      case_when(
        p1 == "no" ~ 0,
        p1 %in% c("remote", "recent") ~ 1,
        p1 == "unknown" ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # Alcohol Use (ordinal): None=0, <=1=1, 2-7=2, >=8=3, Unknown=NA
    # -------------------------
    `Alcohol Use` = {
      a1 <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Alcohol Use`)))
      case_when(
        a1 == "none" ~ 0,
        a1 == "<= 1 drink/week" ~ 1,
        a1 == "2-7 drinks/week" ~ 2,
        a1 == ">= 8 drinks/week" ~ 3,
        a1 == "unknown" ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # Num Dis Vessels (ordinal): None=0, One=1, Two=2, Three=3
    # -------------------------
    `Num Dis Vessels` = {
      n1 <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Num Dis Vessels`)))
      case_when(
        n1 == "none" ~ 0,
        n1 == "one" ~ 1,
        n1 == "two" ~ 2,
        n1 == "three" ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # Status (binary): Elective=0, Urgent=1
    # -------------------------
    Status = {
      s1 <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(Status)))
      case_when(
        s1 == "elective" ~ 0,
        s1 == "urgent" ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # Race merged: 1 White, 2 Black, 3 Asian, 4 Other (AI/AN + NH/PI + Race Other)
    # priority 1->2->3->4
    # -------------------------
    race = {
      r_white <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Race - White`))) == "yes"
      r_black <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Race - Black / African American`))) == "yes"
      r_asian <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Race - Asian`))) == "yes"
      r_ai_an <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Race - American Indian / Alaskan Native`))) == "yes"
      r_nh_pi <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Race - Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander`))) == "yes"
      r_other <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Race Other`))) == "yes"
      other_flag <- r_ai_an | r_nh_pi | r_other

      case_when(
        r_white ~ 1,
        r_black ~ 2,
        r_asian ~ 3,
        other_flag ~ 4,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    },

    # -------------------------
    # Hemoglobin: try to parse numeric; keep NA if not parseable
    # (if the column is truly numeric in Excel, this will still work)
    # -------------------------
    Hemoglobin = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(Hemoglobin)))
  ) %>%
  # --------------------------------------------------
  # 3) drop original race columns + Tobacco Use 1/2
  # --------------------------------------------------
  select(
    -all_of(race_cols),
    -`Tobacco Use 1`,
    -`Tobacco Use 2`
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4) QC prints
# --------------------------------------------------
cat("QC: binary vars should be 0/1/NA\n")
qc_bin <- c(
  "Diabetes","Hypertension","Endocarditis","Sleep Apnea","Illicit Drug Use",
  "Liver Disease","Immunocompromised","PAD","Syncope","CVD","Previous  PCI","Prior MI",
  "tobacco_use"
)
for (v in qc_bin) {
  cat("\n", v, ":\n", sep = "")
  print(table(dat_clean[[v]], useNA = "ifany"))
}

cat("\nQC: CLD (0/1/2/3/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$CLD, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nQC: Pneumonia (0/1/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$Pneumonia, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nQC: Alcohol Use (0/1/2/3/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$`Alcohol Use`, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nQC: Num Dis Vessels (0/1/2/3/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$`Num Dis Vessels`, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nQC: Status (0/1/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$Status, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nQC: race (1/2/3/4/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$race, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nQC: Hemoglobin summary\n")
print(summary(dat_clean$Hemoglobin))




```


```{r qc-readmission-and-nonmissing-rate, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

stopifnot(exists("dat_clean"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) Readmission: Yes=1, No=0  (robust to case/space)
# --------------------------------------------------
stopifnot("Readmission" %in% names(dat_clean))

dat_clean <- dat_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Readmission = case_when(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(Readmission))) == "yes" ~ 1,
      str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(Readmission))) == "no"  ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# quick QC
cat("QC: Readmission (0/1/NA)\n")
print(table(dat_clean$Readmission, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\n")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) For ALL columns: non-missing share = (# rows with value) / (total rows)
# - For character: "" also treated as missing
# - For numeric/logical: only NA treated as missing
# --------------------------------------------------
n_total <- nrow(dat_clean)

nonmissing_report <- tibble(
  column = names(dat_clean),
  n_total = n_total,
  n_nonmissing = vapply(dat_clean, function(x) {
    if (is.character(x)) sum(!is.na(x) & str_trim(x) != "")
    else sum(!is.na(x))
  }, numeric(1)),
  pct_nonmissing = round(100 * n_nonmissing / n_total, 1)
) %>%
  arrange(pct_nonmissing)

cat("Non-missing rate for each column (sorted):\n")
print(nonmissing_report, n = Inf)
cat("\n")
```

```{r drop-two-cols-and-knn-impute-silent-save, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(VIM)
library(here)
library(readr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Assumption: dat_clean already exists
# --------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("dat_clean"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 0) Drop the 2 columns you specified
# --------------------------------------------------
cols_drop_manual <- c("Previous  PCI", "Hemoglobin")
missing_drop <- setdiff(cols_drop_manual, names(dat_clean))
if (length(missing_drop) > 0) {
  stop("These columns are not found in dat_clean: ", paste(missing_drop, collapse = ", "))
}

dat_drop <- dat_clean %>% select(-all_of(cols_drop_manual))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) Missing-rate based dropping (>=10% drop)  [NO printing]
# --------------------------------------------------
missing_rate <- colMeans(is.na(dat_drop))
cols_to_drop_by_missing <- names(missing_rate[missing_rate >= 0.10])
dat_kept <- dat_drop %>% select(-any_of(cols_to_drop_by_missing))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) KNN imputation (same as before) + keep output minimal
# --------------------------------------------------
char_cols <- names(dat_kept)[vapply(dat_kept, is.character, logical(1))]
if (length(char_cols) > 0) {
  dat_kept <- dat_kept %>% mutate(across(all_of(char_cols), as.factor))
}

dat_clean_imputed <- VIM::kNN(dat_kept, k = 5, imp_var = FALSE)

cat("KNN imputation complete!\n")

# optional: safety check (silent)
if (anyNA(dat_clean_imputed)) {
  warning("There are still missing values after kNN imputation.")
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3) Save results to outcomes/s1
# --------------------------------------------------
here::i_am("scripts/processing_dataset-v2.Rmd")

out_fp <- here("outcomes", "s1", "cleaned_dataset_row2_imputed.csv")
readr::write_csv(dat_clean_imputed, out_fp)

cat("Saved imputed dataset to:\n", out_fp, "\n", sep = "")

```
### 上面已经完成 processing data 的过程，下面要做的是检查一下。


```{r column-completeness-check, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(tibble)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1) Read imputed dataset
# --------------------------------------------------
here::i_am("scripts/processing_dataset-v2.Rmd")

in_fp <- here("outcomes", "s1", "cleaned_dataset_row2_imputed.csv")
dat_imp <- readr::read_csv(in_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)

n_total <- nrow(dat_imp)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compute non-missing ratio for each column
# --------------------------------------------------
completeness_tbl <- tibble(
  variable        = names(dat_imp),
  non_missing_n   = colSums(!is.na(dat_imp)),
  total_n         = n_total,
  non_missing_pct = round(non_missing_n / total_n * 100, 2)
) %>%
  arrange(non_missing_pct)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3) Output (clean, no noise)
```
